scripts.check: npm run check:deploy && npm run test:browser
scripts.check:deploy: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ui && npm test
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-server-build.js && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && vite build && node scripts/copy-build-assets.js
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.shared.json tsconfig.build.json tsconfig.client.json playwright.config.js vite.config.js vitest.config.js scripts server shared client browser-smoke compose.yaml .github/workflows/container.yml "documentation/*.md" README.markdown
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.shared.json tsconfig.build.json tsconfig.client.json playwright.config.js vite.config.js vitest.config.js scripts server shared client browser-smoke compose.yaml .github/workflows/container.yml "documentation/*.md" README.markdown
scripts.lint: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --ext .js,.ts,.tsx scripts server shared client browser-smoke playwright.config.js vite.config.js vitest.config.js
scripts.lint:shape: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --ext .js,.ts,.tsx --ignore-pattern "client/src/tools/**" --ignore-pattern "server/test/**" --ignore-pattern "browser-smoke/**" --rule "max-lines: [warn, {max: 500, skipBlankLines: true, skipComments: true}]" --rule "max-lines-per-function: [warn, {max: 120, skipBlankLines: true, skipComments: true}]" --rule "max-statements: [warn, 50]" client/src shared server scripts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.json && tsc --project tsconfig.shared.json && tsc --project tsconfig.client.json
scripts.test:browser:ui: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test --headed --output=playwright-screenshots
